messages:
mina: Kickoff: bringing up new embed candidate 'loom-lite-6b' for onboarding. Plan: fp16 baseline, int8 per-channel probe, and a tiny-int6 experiment for size-constrained customers.
rahul: Love it. Please include recall@1/10/100 on the canonical wiki holdout + per-category slice (finance/legal/health). Also sanity UMAP and silhouette.
chi: Add short-query (<16 tokens) and multilingual pairs (en/fr/es/zh). Those caught regressions last time.
mina: Ran a quick fp16 baseline this morning: recall@1=0.62, recall@10=0.84, recall@100=0.94. Silhouette=0.44. Short-query recall@10=0.70. Uploaded artifacts: gs://redwood-evals/loom-lite/2026-03-23/run-01/
elaine: Can you paste the quant pipeline command so infra can replicate? Also note any perf/latency tradeoffs.
mina: Quant commands used for probes:
```bash
# per-channel int8
python tools/quantize.py --model loom-lite-6b --mode per_channel --bits 8 --calib 4096 --out gs://tmp/loom_int8_pc
# per-tensor int8
python tools/quantize.py --model loom-lite-6b --mode per_tensor --bits 8 --calib 4096 --out gs://tmp/loom_int8_pt
# tiny int6 (experimental)
python tools/quantize.py --model loom-lite-6b --mode per_channel --bits 6 --calib 8192 --clip l2 --out gs://tmp/loom_int6
```
config snippet uploaded with runs.
rahul: Results summary (wiki holdout):
- fp16: R@1=0.62, R@10=0.84, R@100=0.94, silhouette=0.44
- int8 per-tensor: R@1=0.59, R@10=0.80, R@100=0.92, silhouette=0.40
- int8 per-channel: R@1=0.61, R@10=0.83, R@100=0.93, silhouette=0.43
- int6 per-channel: R@1=0.55, R@10=0.76, R@100=0.89, silhouette=0.33
Size delta: int8 pc -6% bytes, int6 -28% bytes vs fp16.
chi: Not bad. Looks like per-channel int8 recovers most of the loss. How about normalization? We saw gains when L2-normalizing embeddings before retrieval.
mina: L2-normalize gave +0.015 R@10 on int8 PC and +0.02 on int6 in the holdout. We also tested dot vs cosine; cosine wins for long-tail categories.
elaine: Latency/throughput notes?
mina: Local perf microbench: FP16 1-token latency = 12.4ms, int8 PC = 9.8ms, int6 = 8.1ms. Batchable throughput improved x2.1 (int8) and x2.7 (int6) at batch=16. No regression in KV cache path.
rahul: Category slices: finance shows a 0.03 mean cosine centroid shift under int6, int8 PT showed 0.02 shift. Per-channel int8 largely mitigates finance drift. Legal/health stable.
chi: Any nondeterminism across microbatches or different runtime backends?
mina: Ran repeatability 10 seeds: max recall variance +-0.006 for int8 PC. We saw one outlier where an int6 run had missing token IDs due to a tokenizer edge-case; filed issue #ML-782.
elaine: Ops note: schedule canary if we want to roll int8 PC. Recommend canary 3% traffic, monitor R@10 daily, and per-category alerts.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled by @elaine: loom-lite-6b:int8-per-channel -> 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z; will post start/finish to #eng-ml.
rahul: Rollout gates suggestion: block on daily R@10 drop >0.01 overall OR any category drop >0.025. Also require long-tail K=100 sweep to pass.
chi: I'll add hard-negative stress tests and the multilingual k-sweep to the eval harness.
mina: Pushed UMAP snapshots and recall tables to the GS path: umap/*.png, recall_slices/*.csv. Quick observation: cluster topology preserved, small hub-and-spoke tightening on int8 PC.
elaine: Please include a compact runbook snippet for the canary (smoke command, rollback steps).
mina: Done  runbook in gs link and short smoke command in the rollout doc. Will post final summary before canary.
chi: Thanks all. Next actions: mina finalize artifacts + run long-tail sweep; chi add hard-negatives; elaine schedule canary ops; rahul finalize release gates.
rahul: TL;DR: per-channel int8 looks acceptable for production with L2-normalize recommended; int6 is interesting for edge but needs more fixes.
mina: Thanks team. I'll ping when long-tail sweep completes.
ops-bot: Reminder: please link the rollback playbook in the canary message.
